paper_metadata.title: Effect of alloying elements in Ni-base substrate material on interdiffusion processes in MCrAlY-coated systems

evidence.quote: Ni-base superalloys are state-of-the-art construction materials for turbine blades and vanes which are exposed to aggressive environments at extremely high temperatures under high mechanical loads

The average volume fraction of remnant β-phase in the coating core of S Ta was measured to be 31.5% that is nearly half of the initial β-phase content in the coating (Section 2.3).
The β-NiAl dissolution is related to the Al, Cr and Co loss due to interdiffusion between the coating and the substrate.
Chemical degradation of the coating systems studied was found to be governed mainly by interdiffusion processes between the coating and the substrate, rather than by oxidation-induced Al loss.
